description: Create or update a single file's content in an existing GitHub repository (write/modify code, config, or text files). Do NOT use for creating repositories, issues, pull requests, or branches — use create_repository, create_issue, create_pull_request, or create_branch instead.

branch.description: Branch to create/update the file in

path.description: Path where to create/update the file

sha.description: SHA of the file being replaced (required when updating existing files)

name: create_or_update_file
